interpretation: Each final_permit cover page defines the governing authorization corpus as the named Parts of that issued permit.
scope: document_kind=final_permit across all three permits in inventory
semantic_delta: Add permit_document_authority relation; map authority_role=ISSUED_GOVERNING_CORPUS for document_kind=final_permit; narrow permit_document_text_not_available unresolved to non-final_permit documents.
remaining_uncertainty: Does not resolve every narrative condition inside permit Parts; only establishes which document corpus governs.

interpretation: part_ii_appendix and part_iv files are binding only as incorporated adjuncts referenced from the issued permit, not as standalone authorization.
semantic_delta: Add permit_document_authority relation; map authority_role=INCORPORATED_BY_REFERENCE for document_kind in (part_ii_appendix, part_iv).
remaining_uncertainty: Specific appendix content must still be read from permit Parts; incorporation does not auto-materialize every narrative condition.

interpretation: Fact sheets, statements of basis, and reasonable-potential files are explanatory or calculation-support package material that defers enforceable limitations to the issued permit.
semantic_delta: Add permit_document_authority relation; map authority_role=SUPPORTING_EXPLANATORY for document_kind in (fact_sheet, statement_of_basis, reasonable_potential).
remaining_uncertainty: Supporting documents may still contain condition-relevant facts (e.g., discharge occurrence triggers) that must be read from governing permit Parts for Purposes B and C.

interpretation: Inventory document_kind and filename are not a precedence hierarchy; document text governs authority and classification.
semantic_delta: Record authority_role=KIND_LABEL_ONLY for all permit_document rows; do not interpret document_kind as binding precedence.
remaining_uncertainty: Does not establish a general EPA-wide rule; corpus-local observation only.

interpretation: NPDES permit packages universally rank document kinds (final_permit > fact_sheet > statement_of_basis > reasonable_potential) for conflict resolution.
remaining_uncertainty: Would require corpus-wide or regulatory text licensing a global kind hierarchy.

interpretation: Without an explicit 'in the event of conflict' clause, no functional precedence exists among package documents.
exact_grounding: issued-permit self-definition and draft/proposed framing refute total unknowability
remaining_uncertainty: Functional precedence from issued-permit self-definition is source-established; absence of named conflict clause is not total absence of precedence.
Requires workspace text linking minor_modification to issued permit incorporation or supersession.
